description_en: Deploys an SDG to compute instances
kebab_example: aliyun ens deploy-instance-sdg --instance-ids aic-1 --sdg-id sdg-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeployInstanceSDG

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs. The value is a JSON array. A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 实例的编号列表。参数为一个带有格式的JSON数组，最多100个ID
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The SDG deployment type. Set the value to shared, which indicates read/write splitting shared deployment. In this mode, the SDG content is read-only, and data updates are written to the local storage of the instance.

This parameter is required. Currently, only the value shared is supported. If this parameter is not specified, the service returns a Parameter.Invalid error
parameters.help_zh:
SDG部署类型，取值shared表示读写分离共享部署，SDG内容只读，数据更新内容写入实例本地。

此参数实际为必填项，当前仅支持 shared；未提供时服务返回 Parameter.Invalid
parameters.name: deployment_type

parameters.help_en:
The cloud disk type of the shared disk to be created. Valid values:

standard: standard cloud disk.
rbd: RBD cloud disk.


If this parameter is not specified, a standard cloud disk is created by default.
An RBD shared disk can be created only when the source disk type is RBD
parameters.help_zh:
生产的共享盘磁盘类型：

standard(标准云盘)。
rbd（rbd云盘）。


不指定共享盘磁盘类型时默认生成标准云盘。
仅母盘类型为rbd时支持生成rbd共享盘
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en:
The cloud disk access protocol type. Valid values:

iscsi: the default protocol for standard cloud disks. Both RBD cloud disks and standard cloud disks support this protocol.

rbd: the default protocol for RBD cloud disks. Only RBD cloud disks support this mount protocol
parameters.help_zh:
云盘访问协议类型：

iscsi：标准云盘默认协议，rbd云盘和标准云盘都支持该协议。

rbd：rbd云盘默认协议，只有rbd云盘支持该挂载协议
parameters.name: disk_access_protocol

Message.description_en: The response message. The value success is returned if the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 响应消息，若成功请求为success

Result.description_en: The execution result of the synchronous request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether all requests are successful. Valid values:

true: All requests are successful.
false: Some requests failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否全部成功。取值说明如下：

true：全部成功。
false：存在失败任务
